title: Rural Home Loans Program Credit Standards: Entry Requirements and Loan Limits
content:
Each Rural Home Loans product of the Country Home program is offered only within the entry requirements and the loan, value and homesite limits below. The figures are product terms of the Country Home 15-Year Fixed, Country Home 20-Year Fixed, Country Home 30-Year Fixed, Country Home 5/6 Adjustable, Country Home 7/6 Adjustable and Country Home Jumbo 30-Year Fixed.

## Terms defined

- **Smallest loan** — smallest original principal, USD.
- **Largest loan** — largest original principal, USD (the 2026 conforming limit for one-unit homes caps the non-jumbo products).
- **Purchase loan-to-value limit** — largest original principal as a percentage of the original value for a purchase.
- **Refinance loan-to-value limit** — largest original principal as a percentage of appraised value for a rate-and-term refinance.
- **Homesite acreage limit** — largest homesite acreage financed as a rural home; larger tracts are financed as farm real estate.
- **Manufactured home eligibility** — whether a manufactured home on a permanent foundation titled as real estate is eligible (yes or no).
- **Loans by occupancy** — Country Home loans a member may hold at once, by occupancy.

## Entry requirements by product

| Product | Occupancy accepted | Minimum credit score | Maximum debt-to-income | Reserves |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Country Home 15-Year Fixed | primary residence, second home | 640 | 43.0 percent | — |
| Country Home 20-Year Fixed | primary residence, second home | 640 | 43.0 percent | — |
| Country Home 30-Year Fixed | primary residence, second home | 660 | 43.0 percent | — |
| Country Home 5/6 Adjustable | primary residence, second home | 680 | 41.0 percent | — |
| Country Home 7/6 Adjustable | primary residence, second home | 680 | 41.0 percent | — |
| Country Home Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | primary residence only | 720 | 40.0 percent | at least 12 months |

## Loan, value and homesite limits by product

| Product | Smallest loan (USD) | Largest loan (USD) | Purchase LTV limit | Refinance LTV limit | Homesite acreage limit | Manufactured home eligible |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Country Home 15-Year Fixed | 50000.00 | 832750.00 | 95 percent | 90 percent | 40 acres | yes |
| Country Home 20-Year Fixed | 50000.00 | 832750.00 | 95 percent | 90 percent | 40 acres | yes |
| Country Home 30-Year Fixed | 50000.00 | 832750.00 | 95 percent | 90 percent | 40 acres | yes |
| Country Home 5/6 Adjustable | 75000.00 | 832750.00 | 90 percent | 85 percent | 40 acres | no |
| Country Home 7/6 Adjustable | 75000.00 | 832750.00 | 90 percent | 85 percent | 40 acres | no |
| Country Home Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | 832750.01 | 2000000.00 | 80 percent | 75 percent | 80 acres | no |

## Loans a member may hold at once, by occupancy

| Product | Primary residence | Second home |
|---|---|---|
| Every Country Home product listed above | 1 | 1 |

## Reading the limits

- The Country Home Jumbo 30-Year Fixed begins one cent above the largest loan of the other five products: 832750.00 USD is the top of the non-jumbo range and 832750.01 USD is the bottom of the jumbo range.
- A homesite of exactly 40 acres is within the limit of the first five products; a homesite of 40.5 acres is not, and only the Country Home Jumbo 30-Year Fixed, at up to 80 acres, takes it.
- *Hypothetical illustration:* a purchase at an original value of 300000.00 USD on the Country Home 30-Year Fixed may carry original principal of up to 95 percent of that value, that is 285000.00 USD; the same value refinanced on that product may carry up to 90 percent, that is 270000.00 USD.
